subject: Re: Staged evaluation — MAP checkpoints, pricing scenarios, and finalization timeline
messages:
From: Eleni Park <eleni@clearviewhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Carl Hoffman <carl.hoffman@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged evaluation scope and MAP kickoff

Rishi — thanks for the great demo last week. We’ve pulled together our internal evaluation asks and a preliminary timeline (attached). Two items we need to lock down before the execs greenlight the POC: pricing range for the 8-week eval (including any trial credits) and a clear set of MAP checkpoints that map to procurement milestones.

High level:
- Week 0–2: sandbox + integration (success = production connectivity + 50 test prompts)
- Week 3–5: accuracy/cost validation (success = 3 benchmark prompts within target latency and cost)
- Week 6–8: ramp to pilot (success = internal stakeholder signoff + 10k tokens/day simulated)

Procurement will want committed volume, discount schedule tied to MAP checkpoints, and an escape clause if latency/quality targets aren’t met. Can you send a commercial outline and any MAP template you’d propose?

I attached our evaluation requirements doc — happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Best,
Eleni Park
Director of Data & AI — ClearView Health
E: eleni@clearviewhealth.com
A: Attachment: ClearView_Eval_Reqs.docx (docx, 72 KB)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Eleni Park <eleni@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Carl Hoffman <carl.hoffman@clearviewhealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged evaluation scope and MAP kickoff

Eleni — thanks for the clear timeline and doc. Attached are two things: (1) a proposed MAP worksheet (Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx) that maps checkpoints to commercial triggers, and (2) a short PDF with three pricing scenarios and the associated ramp/discount mechanics (Pricing_Scenarios.pdf). Quick summary below so your procurement and legal teams have something to review immediately.

Proposed commercial highlights (summary):
- Eval credits: $20k platform credit applied during the 8-week eval if integration completes by Week 2.
- Committed minimums: 6-month pilot commit at 25% discount off list for first tranche (committed tokens = 2M tokens/mo), escalating to 35% at tranche 2 if MAP checkpoint 2 is met.
- MAP checkpoint triggers:
  * CP1 (end of Week 2): integration & connectivity verified — unlock $10k credit and sandbox SLA guarantees
  * CP2 (end of Week 5): accuracy & latency targets met — trigger tranche 1 billing and 25% discount baseline
  * CP3 (end of Week 8): pilot signoff — triggers tranche 2 pricing and additional 10% discount if commit uplift achieved
- Escape clause: if CP2 latency or quality metrics are missed by more than 15% vs targets, customer may terminate without penalty or roll back to a lower-commit plan within 30 days.

I flagged two scenarios in the PDF: conservative (lower credits, higher ramp commitment) and flexible (larger eval credit, shorter commit window). If procurement needs a special concession (shorter payment terms, extra credit), please indicate and I’ll loop in finance.

Attaching the files for review. Happy to jump on a call with procurement this week.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
M: +1 (415) 555-0124
A: Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 95 KB); Pricing_Scenarios.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Staged evaluation — concession ask and timeline compression

Rishi / Priyom — forwarding Eleni’s note and your proposal. Procurement is likely to push for a larger eval credit and a 90-day payment term if we want to win competitive slotting. Two asks from my side before we send the consolidated proposal to the customer:

1) Can we support an incremental $10k credit (total $30k) if they sign SOW by 12/30? This would be a conditional concession tied to CP1 completion.
2) Re-evaluate the escape clause: can we narrow the tolerance band to 10% instead of 15% if we reduce credit? That reduces downside for us.

If we agree, I’ll approve the customer-facing doc — otherwise we need a quick EPD waiver. Priyom, please add any lift/cost math for the extra credit and confirm impact to ARR and gross margin.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
GM, Mid-Market Accounts — Redwood Inference
A: No attachments on this forward

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Staged evaluation — concession ask and timeline compression

Marissa / Rishi — ran the numbers. Net of expected uplift, an incremental $10k one-time credit reduces first-quarter cash by ~$8.2k after factoring in activation timing, but the expected pilot conversion probability increases by ~22% (historical analogs). Key notes:

- If we grant $30k eval credit conditioned on SOW signed by 12/30, we should hard-code a clawback: if CP2 is not achieved within 60 days of pilot start, $15k of the credit converts to a prepayment that will be deducted from future invoices.
- I can tighten the escape-clause tolerance to 10%, but legal will require explicit metric definitions in the SOW (latency P50/P95 windows, and a small prompt-level eval set).
- This concession requires a one-off finance approval for deferred revenue accounting; I’ll prep the request if you want to proceed.

Recommend: approve $30k conditional credit + $15k clawback + 10% escape tolerance + explicit metric appendix. I’ll draft the brief for finance/legal.

—Priyom
Principal Commercial Analyst — Redwood Inference
A: Attachment: internal model (not customer-facing)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Eleni Park <eleni@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Carl Hoffman <carl.hoffman@clearviewhealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated MAP & commercial proposal (conditional credit + SOW link)

Eleni / Carl — thanks for the patience. Attached is the consolidated MAP (Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx) and the commercial summary PDF reflecting the team’s agreed concessions. Highlights (finalized):

- Eval credit: $30,000 one-time (conditioned on SOW signed by 2026-12-30). $15,000 is subject to clawback if CP2 is not achieved within 60 days of pilot start.
- Commit & discounts: 6-month pilot with initial commit 2M tokens/mo at 25% discount; if CP3 (pilot signoff) achieved and commit uplift to 5M tokens/mo is accepted within 30 days, an incremental 10% discount applies to tranche 2.
- MAP checkpoints: CP1 (integration) / CP2 (accuracy & latency) / CP3 (pilot signoff) with explicit pass/fail metrics in Appendix A.
- Escape: if CP2 misses metrics by >10% (per Appendix A), customer may elect to terminate or convert to a reduced-commit plan without penalty; otherwise the contract proceeds.
- Timing: we’re targeting SOW signature and DocuSign routing by 2026-12-30 to qualify for the $30k conditional credit.

DocuSign link to SOW: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/RDW-5472-CV-SOW (see SOW_DocuSign_Link.txt attached). Please review and confirm — if you’re comfortable, signing the SOW will lock the timeline and credit. We can also set a short legal call to walk through Appendix A.

Warm regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
E: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0124
A: Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx; Pricing_Scenarios.pdf; SOW_DocuSign_Link.txt

From: Eleni Park <eleni@clearviewhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Carl Hoffman <carl.hoffman@clearviewhealth.com>, procurement@clearviewhealth.com
Date: Mon, 22 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated MAP & commercial proposal (conditional credit + SOW link)

Rishi — thanks, this is exactly the clarity we needed. We are supportive of the $30k credit tied to 12/30 signature and understand the clawback mechanics. Two small asks from procurement before we sign:

1) Can payment terms be Net 45 instead of Net 30 on the pilot invoices?
2) Can you include our procurement contact (procurement@clearviewhealth.com) on the SOW routing so they receive the final DocuSign packet?

If you can confirm those two items, I’ll route internally and we should be able to sign by 12/30 to qualify for the credit. Looking forward to the Appendix A details in the SOW.

Best,
Eleni Park
Director of Data & AI — ClearView Health
A: Attachment: procurement-contact.vcf (vcard, 2 KB)
